speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether there have been any benefits to the environment and wildlife from reducing the frequency of green verge maintenance along public roads and paths during the COVID-19 circuit breaker period; and (b) whether reduced maintenance frequencies can be permanently implemented to save public expenditure, reduce foreign manpower needs and to improve biodiversity.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: These Nature Ways use multi-tiered planting of native trees, shrubs and ground cover to replicate the natural structures of forests.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For example, tall grass may conceal discarded litter, making dengue control operations more difficult.
